assets.name: fb-desk
assets.prompt: An animator's light table seen exactly straight from above. A slate gray-blue painted wooden frame surrounds a large softly glowing frosted white glass panel. The glass is an unobstructed rectangle occupying x=12 to 88 percent and y=10 to 88 percent of the image. A short metal peg bar with three pegs sits along the bottom edge below the glass. Two graphite pencils, a red pencil and delicate curled pencil shavings rest on the far left and right wooden frame, entirely outside the glass. Small screws, worn painted wood edges, subtle wood grain, soft shadows. The middle is luminous blank glass with plenty of room for a digital sheet of paper. Richly detailed, inviting real artist's equipment, soft evening light.
